query: DoorDash Online Ordering 0% commission direct vs Marketplace 15-30% KEEP dual-run

hits.snippet: Restaurant owners: DoorDash Online Ordering is 0% commission on direct orders from your website/social/Google — Marketplace still takes 15-30%. Dual-run discovery on DoorDash then shift KEEP guests to direct or Never86 buy-now; Drive On-Demand is flat fee fulfillment not percent rent.
hits.never86_angle: Teach marketplace_direct_zero: DD OO proves 0% direct exists — Never86 TikTok/IG buy-now is the love→close channel that keeps social demand without Marketplace %

notes: Sources: DoorDash merchants OO pages + fee explainers via Composio Tavily. Bright Data still 401. Skip forecasting. Not expanding swarm imports.
